note: A repeater with two subfields, printed by the generic output: an accordion of details elements that works without JavaScript.

items.a: No. The fields run on Advanced Custom Fields (free) and on Secure Custom Fields. Both are detected, neither is required for the output.

items.q: What happens to existing pages on an update?
items.a: The data stays where it is. If a version renames a stored key, a migration moves the content along — automatically, and additionally through a WP-CLI command with a dry run.

items.q: Can I create my own components?
items.a: Yes: a directory with definition.json, render.php and component.css. The component then appears in the component list and in the inserter.

items.q: Does it work without JavaScript in the frontend?
items.a: Yes. The output is HTML and CSS; accordions are details elements, ratings a meter element. Only the editor needs JavaScript.
